notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- fix bug causing the aim animation to stuck when you switch between third person and first person mode quickly
- fix bug causing to reload without showing the reload animation in some situations 
- fix bug causing CERBERUS to not bite in the correct player location
- fix bug causing CERBERUS to not deal damage when he bites sometimes
- fix bug causing CERBERUS to walk in a buggy way after he jumps
